verses.sanskrit:
शौर्यं धैर्यं बलं वीर्यं प्राणत्यागपराक्रमम् ।
धर्मो रथस्य केतुश्च तत्र वै विजयो ध्रुवम् ॥
verses.translation: Valor, patience, strength, heroism, self-sacrifice, and bravery — when dharma is the banner of the chariot, then victory is certain.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यं शीलं दया धर्मो सुनयो विनयो नृणाम् ।
एते असत्र शस्त्राणि जेतुं लोकमनामयम् ॥
verses.translation: Truth, good character, compassion, dharma, righteousness, and modesty — these are the true weapons for mortals to conquer the world of suffering.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य एते चतुरो भागाः सत्यं धर्मो दमः क्षमा ।
तम् अरीन् नैव सेवन्ते विजयः तस्य निश्चितम् ॥
verses.translation: He who possesses these four qualities — truth, dharma, self-control, and forgiveness — enemies cannot overpower him, and his victory is assured.
